description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Stone Retrieval Unit, adding {C}{C}.
Stone Retrieval Unit dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Stone Retrieval Unit from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Stone Retrieval Unit enters the battlefield, creating a Powerstone token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Powerstone, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
